title: Concept: pyproject declares no supported Python range
description: pyproject.toml declares a pyproject that records no `requires-python` range, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Nothing states which interpreter the project supports, so a resolver can install it on a runtime its dependencies never supported.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: Nothing states which interpreter the project supports, so a resolver can install it on a runtime its dependencies never supported.
